    • getLastAttempts

      public List<QuizAttemptDTO> getLastAttempts(User user)
      Retrieves the last 10 quiz attempts made by the specified user.

      This method fetches the most recent quiz attempts from the repository, maps each attempt to a QuizAttemptDTO, and returns them as a list. If there are no attempts, an empty list is returned.

      Logs are generated for both successful retrieval and errors.

      Specified by:
      getLastAttempts in interface IQuizAttemptService
      Parameters:
      user - the User whose last quiz attempts are to be fetched
      Returns:
      a List of QuizAttemptDTO representing the user's last 10 quiz attempts; the list is empty if the user has no attempts
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if there is an error accessing the repository or mapping the attempts

    • getLastAttempt

      public Optional<QuizAttemptDTO> getLastAttempt(User user)
      Retrieves the most recent quiz attempt made by the specified user.

      This method queries the repository for the latest QuizAttempt based on the attempt date, maps it to a QuizAttemptDTO, and returns it wrapped in an Optional. If the user has not made any quiz attempts, the returned Optional will be empty.

      Detailed logs are generated for both successful retrieval and error scenarios.

      Specified by:
      getLastAttempt in interface IQuizAttemptService
      Parameters:
      user - the User whose last quiz attempt is to be retrieved
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the most recent QuizAttemptDTO if available, or an empty Optional if the user has no quiz attempts
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an unexpected error occurs while fetching or mapping the quiz attempt

    • mapToDTO

      public QuizAttemptDTO mapToDTO(QuizAttempt attempt)
      Maps a QuizAttempt entity to a QuizAttemptDTO.

      This method transforms a QuizAttempt object into a data transfer object (DTO) that contains only the information needed by the frontend. It also maps each QuestionAttempt within the attempt to a QuestionAttemptDTO.

      Parameters:
      attempt - the QuizAttempt entity to map
      Returns:
      a QuizAttemptDTO containing:
      • Attempt ID
      • Marks obtained
      • Number of correct answers
      • Number of attempted questions
      • Attempt date
      • List of QuestionAttemptDTO objects representing each question attempt
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if attempt or its question attempts are null

    • findByUserAndQuizOrderByAttemptDateAsc

      public List<QuizAttempt> findByUserAndQuizOrderByAttemptDateAsc(User user, Quiz quiz)
      Retrieves all quiz attempts made by a specific user for a given quiz, ordered by attempt date in ascending order.

      This method queries the repository for all QuizAttempt entities associated with the provided User and Quiz. The results are sorted chronologically (oldest first). This is useful for tracking a user's progress over multiple quiz attempts.

      Logs are generated for successful retrievals as well as any errors encountered during repository access.

      Specified by:
      findByUserAndQuizOrderByAttemptDateAsc in interface IQuizAttemptService
      Parameters:
      user - the User whose quiz attempts are to be retrieved
      quiz - the Quiz for which the attempts are to be retrieved
      Returns:
      a List of QuizAttempt objects representing all attempts made by the user for the given quiz, sorted by attempt date (ascending)
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an error occurs while fetching the data from the repository

    • deleteAttempt

      public void deleteAttempt(QuizAttempt attempt)
      Deletes a specific quiz attempt from the database.

      This method removes the given QuizAttempt entity from the repository. It is typically used when an attempt needs to be invalidated, reset, or removed due to user action or administrative reasons.

      Informational and debug logs are generated for successful deletions, while any errors encountered during the process are logged and rethrown.

      Specified by:
      deleteAttempt in interface IQuizAttemptService
      Parameters:
      attempt - the QuizAttempt entity to be deleted; must not be null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an error occurs during the deletion process

    • getTopQuizzesByAttempts

      public List<PopularQuizStatsDTO> getTopQuizzesByAttempts()
      Retrieves a list of quizzes ordered by the total number of attempts in descending order.

      This method queries the repository for all quizzes, counts how many times each quiz has been attempted, and returns the results as a list of PopularQuizStatsDTO. The list is sorted from the most attempted quiz to the least attempted.

      Logs are generated for both the start of the operation and the number of quizzes retrieved. Any exception encountered during repository access is logged and rethrown.

      Specified by:
      getTopQuizzesByAttempts in interface IQuizAttemptService
      Returns:
      a List of PopularQuizStatsDTO representing quizzes with the most attempts; the list may be empty if there are no quiz attempts
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an error occurs while accessing the repository

    • getTopQuizzesByAverageScore

      public List<PopularQuizStatsDTO> getTopQuizzesByAverageScore()
      Retrieves a list of quizzes ordered by the average score in descending order.

      This method queries the repository for all quizzes, calculates the average score obtained for each quiz across all attempts, and returns the results as a list of PopularQuizStatsDTO. The list is sorted from the highest average score to the lowest.

      Logs are generated for both the start of the operation and the number of quizzes retrieved. Any exception encountered during repository access is logged and rethrown.

      Specified by:
      getTopQuizzesByAverageScore in interface IQuizAttemptService
      Returns:
      a List of PopularQuizStatsDTO representing quizzes with the highest average score; the list may be empty if there are no quiz attempts
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an error occurs while accessing the repository
